latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of skylv-diff-viewer: a professional side-by-side code diff tool.

- Unified and side-by-side code comparisons with LCS-based diff algorithm
- Syntax highlighting, word-level diffs, and directory comparison support
- Standalone HTML export with dark theme and stats
- Git integration for repository-level diffs
- Outperforms basic competitors with a full-featured tool for code review and comparison
